no; evidence — `store/db/db.go` is the only file in the repo that imports `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` (`grep -rln 'store/db/mysql"' --include="*.go"` returns just that file), and it calls `mysql.NewDB(profile)` inside the `NewDBDriver` factory (store/db/db.go:22). Every other call site that needs a driver goes through this factory: `server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_benchmark_test.go:70` and `store/test/store.go:28,50` all call `db.NewDBDriver(...)`, never `mysql.NewDB` or `mysql.DB{}` directly. The MySQL-related code in `store/test/containers.go` (e.g. `sql.Open("mysql", dsn)` at line 145, and use of `github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql` / `testcontainers-go/modules/mysql`) only spins up a raw `*sql.DB`/test container for connectivity checks and DSN rewriting — it never constructs the project's `mysql.DB` store driver type from `store/db/mysql/mysql.go`.
